descriptor: B2B maker of CZ-studded gold jewellery
lede: A Mumbai manufacturer of 22-carat studded gold jewellery for organised retailers that doubled revenue after its 2025 IPO and is tripling capacity. It looks cheap at ~14x trailing earnings, but much of last year's profit came from gold bought before the price rally; on management's own 4% core margin the stock is closer to 26x, and cash flow has been negative for years.

short_version.text: Revenue +82% to ₹2,019 Cr in FY26 and +145% to ₹716 Cr in Q1 FY27 on 61% higher volumes; the new Marol plant (4,000 kg a year) started in June and Jaipur (1,200 kg) follows by December. ROCE 34%.

FY26's 6.9% PAT margin included ~3 points of gold-price gains; management guides a core 3.5-4%. Inventory accounting switched from FIFO to weighted average (FY26 PAT ₹140 Cr vs ₹193 Cr under FIFO), operating cash flow was –₹261 Cr, and a ₹100 Cr rights issue followed the IPO within a year.
~14x trailing earnings and ~11x EV/EBITDA, against Sky Gold at 38x and RBZ Jewellers at 14x; on core earnings of ~4% of trailing revenue, about 26x.

blocks.text: Shanti Gold designs and manufactures 22-carat (and some 18-carat) cubic-zirconia-studded gold jewellery, mainly bridal and designer pieces, in Andheri, Mumbai, and sells to more than 400 organised jewellery retailers. In FY26 it added machine-made plain gold, mangalsutras and Turkish jewellery, and it is setting up a Dubai office for exports.

items.text: Earns a making margin on gold it buys from banks and bullion dealers; studded bridal pieces earn more, plain gold less.
Holds ready stock for retailers rather than working order-to-order, which ties up cash.
Unhedged gold bought with IPO money produced inventory gains in FY26 and Q1 FY27.
IPO in August 2025; revenue from ₹428 Cr (FY22) to ₹2,019 Cr (FY26).
Promoters also run Utssav CZ Gold Jewels, a separately listed B2B jeweller.
Inventory valuation moved from FIFO to weighted average cost, retrospective from April 2024.

blocks.title: Net profit vs operating cash flow, ₹ Cr

items.lead: Profit has never turned into cash:
items.text: ₹244 Cr of profit over FY22-26 against –₹309 Cr of operating cash flow, funded by debt, the IPO and now a rights issue.
under FIFO, FY26 PAT would have been ₹193 Cr instead of ₹140 Cr; the deferred gain flowed into Q1 FY27 (~2-2.5 points of margin).
debt/equity 0.36x at March 2026 (from 1.8x), 0.5x by June; management is comfortable up to 1x.
on ~₹506 Cr of capital added FY24-26, but helped by gold-price gains.

items.text: Volumes keep growing ~35% a year: ~₹4,800 Cr revenue in FY28 at a 4.5% PAT margin (₹216 Cr), valued at 16x.

items.name: Base
items.text: Guidance met then 30%: ~₹4,070 Cr revenue at the 4% core margin (₹163 Cr), valued at 14x.

items.name: Bear
items.text: Gold falls and volumes slow: ~₹3,300 Cr at a 3% margin (₹99 Cr), valued at 10x.

items.label: P/E on 4% core margin of trailing revenue

blocks.text: Shanti Gold is growing fast and adding capacity in a market that is shifting to organised retail. But the low headline P/E flatters it: last year's profit leaned on gold-price gains, the business has never generated operating cash, and growth requires repeated capital raises. Value it on the 4% core margin, not the reported one.
